ThingDef.label: Iron Nanny
ThingDef.description: A huge soulless machine with a deeply damaged AI. It is not known who the creator is and what the purpose of its existence is. The robot is aggressive.

ThingDef.label: Steam cow
ThingDef.description: An ancient mechanical creature created at the same time as the automatons for unknown purposes. The creators of this creature were apparently inspired by its living counterpart - the domestic cow. Steam cows are actively used by fairly developed factions to produce coal: the cows have an algorithm built into them that forces them to process grass and wood into coke coal, taking part of the burned energy as fuel.

It is used by developed factions to obtain naphtha, which the creature produces, taking part of the burned energy for itself as fuel.
